content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-97 (bundled/not separately payable), which has persisted across four touches despite appeal, correction, and records submission. This is a bundling dispute, not medical necessity or authorization. The payer offers peer-to-peer review, which is the appropriate next step to argue that CPT 93271 is separately payable and unbundle it clinician-to-clinician. Resubmitting again would risk CO-18, and timely filing is nearly exhausted anyway.", "action": "request_peer_to_peer"}
